text: The meeting identified preparation and coordination gaps, evidenced by kickoff participation being slow and under-prepared. Pricing was decided at 25 Euros. A sales target of 50 million Euros was set, and production cost should be half of the selling price. Phase one will be the functional design, with the project assuming a TV/video system scope and potential future features; the product should be user-friendly and minimize functions to simplify usage. Industrial Designer will work on the conceptual design; the Project Manager will summarize the discussed items into the project folder; and the User Interface Designer will specify the technical functions.
